description: This file defines a Java interface 'FilterFieldExpressionVisitor' which extends another interface 'SortFieldExpressionVisitor'. It provides method signatures for visiting different types of filter field expressions within a query expression framework, specifically handling attribute, feature ID property, and simple field name cases.

classes.name: FilterFieldExpressionVisitor
classes.description: A generic interface for visitors that process different filter field expressions, extending the 'SortFieldExpressionVisitor' interface and adding specific methods for attribute, feature ID property, and simple field visits.

methods.name: visitAttribute
methods.description: Method to handle visiting an attribute expression identified by a key.

methods.name: visitFeatureIdProperty
methods.description: Method to handle visiting a feature ID property expression, taking featureId and property as parameters.

methods.name: visitSimple
methods.description: Method to handle visiting a simple field name expression.
